summary: Applies directional diffuse lighting and ambient illumination to 2D or 3D raster input.
summaryText: Applies directional diffuse lighting and ambient illumination to 2D or 3D raster input.
remarks: With [`RasterRenderer.Geometry`](<xref:RasterRenderer#Geometry>) supplied, shades covered samples before MSAA resolve. Otherwise lights the input image using optional normals. This technique does not compute HRC transmission or path-traced indirect light.
